118841.synopsis:
That little junior sister stole my spiritual root and took away my chance at fortune, so I crippled her with a single strike.
Fu Xi was the eldest senior sister of the Sword-Leaning Sect—hardworking in her cultivation and respected by her peers. But everything changed when her master brought back that little junior sister.
The once-respected master began risking the entire sect multiple times just for that junior sister. The second senior brother secretly gave her slow-acting poison so she wouldn’t feel inferior. And when she was on the brink of death, the third senior brother even suggested giving her spiritual root to the little junior sister…
The system told her that all of this happened because this world was actually a dark power-leveling novel with a domineering male lead, and she was nothing more than cannon fodder in a footnote.
Fu Xi refused to accept her fate. With her broken body, she dragged herself into the depths of the sect’s forbidden grounds and threw herself into the ancient divine sword, the Hengcang Sword, becoming its sword spirit.
From there, she made her way to the future male lead.
At this point, the male lead hadn’t turned into that blood-soaked force of destruction, killing gods and demons alike on his way to the top.
So Fu Xi, now a sword spirit, chose to stay hidden by his side, waiting for him to embark on his cultivation journey—so she could return to the Sword-Leaning Sect and get her revenge.
Only… Fu Xi looked at the male lead, still just a kid, and fell into deep thought.
How exactly is a sword spirit supposed to raise a child?
Later—
Male Lead: They say a sword cultivator’s sword is like their wife, right? So hey, wifey!
Fu Xi: …………
Where did it all go wrong?

137529.synopsis:
Yu Qinglong was the undisputed king of arguments in K University’s Faculty of Law.
 He studied with all his might, graduated with excellent grades, and was all set to shine brightly in the legal world.
 Who would have thought that one farewell dinner with his dormmates would send him tumbling into an unheard-of dynasty—reborn as a ge’er despised by every neighboring village and hamlet.
 What the hell?!
 Was all that studying for nothing?!
With no one to hear his grievances, Yu Qinglong finally snapped.
The neighbors sneered that he was too tall and strong to look like a ge’er?
 Yu Qinglong: “Oh? Does it hurt your pride that I make your man look short and scrawny?”
The rotten relatives said he had a bad temper and would never marry?
 Yu Qinglong: “Not getting married is perfect! That way I can spend every day educating you loud-mouthed fish about the philosophy of life.”
Before Yu Qinglong’s arrival, the original ge’er couldn’t even lift his head when walking.
 A month after the transmigration, even the fiercest dogs in the village would take a detour upon seeing him.
Poor? Then he’d make money!
 Rotten relatives? He’d find a way to bring them down!
 In his life, there was only moving forward—never retreating!
But then they said he was too fierce to find a husband?
 Ha! As if he ever wanted to get married!
 Yet unexpectedly, Fang Shu, the well-known scholar from the neighboring village, sent a matchmaker to propose.
Yu Qinglong eyed the tall but slender, somewhat frail scholar and asked, “What do you even like about me?”
 Fang Shu replied, “I find it satisfying when you curse people—and you’re also good at making all sorts of fun little things.”
 Yu Qinglong: “I do some handicrafts, sure. But just so you know, I might end up cursing you too.”
 Fang Shu: “For example?”
 Yu Qinglong: “You’re so thin, a gust of wind could blow you away like a blanket for the earth! Go exercise!”
 Fang Shu thought about it. “You’re right!”
 The next day, he began working out in earnest!
At first, Fang Shu thought: My husband is so good at crafting wooden toys; I should treat him well just for that.
 But later, Fang Shu changed. As he kissed the plum blossom mark on Yu Qinglong’s shoulder, he thought: For this shoulder, this waist—dying would be worth it!
The Fang family had been firmly against Yu Qinglong joining their household, but to everyone’s shock, once he did, their son’s health improved dramatically, and his studies flourished!
 Madam Fang proudly declared, “If anyone dares to say my Qinglong isn’t good enough, I’ll curse them to death!”
Yu Qinglong: “Perfect. Shared ideals make for lifelong harmony!”
A mentally fierce, sharp-tongued, dazzlingly handsome transmigrated uke
 VS
 A top student, poor at comebacks, physically weak but deeply addicted, local scholar seme who loves handicrafts
Also known as: “My Husband Speaks My Mind” and “My Husband Crafts Toys for Me”

170809.synopsis:
The young Liu Yunbao dreamed of a story about a “Real and Fake Young Master.”
In the story, the Real Young Master lived a displaced life full of grievances.
The Fake Young Master, upon learning the truth, found it impossible to accept.
And he? He was the adoptive older brother of the Real Young Master and the biological older brother of the Fake Young Master—a genuine, dirt-covered country bumpkin!
Liu Yun flicked his sleeves: “Real young master, fake young master—aren’t they both just younger brothers?”
More than ten years later, Liu Yun achieved the Lianzhong Liuyuan (ranking first in all six levels of the imperial examinations), topping the high school honors list!
On that same day, the Marquis Mansion arrived at his door to speak of the events from years ago, but they lacked the cold arrogance found in his dream.
The Fake Young Master was no longer filled with the panic and unease from the story; instead, he looked curiously at Liu Yun, who sat atop a tall horse.
Only the Real Young Master remained full of grievances, tugging at Liu Yun’s sleeve and asking: “Brother, do you not want me anymore?”

One day, Sang Ling dragged a blood-soaked corpse out of a corner. Feeling pity, she specially washed the corpse’s face and hands. Hmm, looks quite decent now, much better. Clocking out exactly on time, Sang Ling tucked her ID badge into her locker. The locker bore her pseudonym: “Bao Fu” (Get Rich). Life really has something to look forward to.
